extracted.name: Pesto Pasta Salad Recipe
extracted.description: This easy Pesto Pasta Salad only requires 6 ingredients and a few minutes to prepare, made with pesto, tomatoes, mozzarella and any bite-size noodles.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces farfalle pasta (, whole wheat or white)
3/4 cup basil pesto (, homemade or store bought)
2 cups cherry tomatoes (, halved (I use half red and half yellow))
3 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese (, cut into 1/2-inch cubes)
instruction_lines: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Add pasta to a large bowl and stir in pesto.
Add tomatoes, cucumber and fresh mozzarella cubes and toss to combine. Top with parmesan cheese. Garnish with fresh cracked pepper, if desired.
